title: docs(skills): objectstack-ui actions rule names the selection key a bulk body receives
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4n2wzAmmp4Z6W5jsqtM2qx)_
Fixes #35647
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:照着界面技能写「批量操作」的作者,以前会写出一个读不到所选记录的按钮;现在技能教的是两种真正能拿到记录的接法,示例用的是「每条勾选记录执行一次」的那一种。「新标签页打开」的示例也改成了能取到当前记录的写法。
- 为什么做:属于「对外发布的技能包教的内容要和运行时一致」这条线,替按技能生成应用的作者和 AI 解决「按钮点了显示成功、实际一条都没处理」的问题。
- 出错会怎样:只改技能文字、示例和一条评测用例,不动运行时;写错的话作者拿到的仍是一段错误示例,直接回退这个 PR 即可。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

State at head `a7f91e14` (round 3, four commits). One wiring story throughout: a name in the list view's `bulkActions` runs the action once per ticked row and the body reads that row as `ctx.recordId`; a `bulkActionDefs` entry with `operation: 'custom', execution: 'aggregate'` runs it once and the body reads the ids as `input._selectedIds`.

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` (published catalog), paid in place:

- **Opening paragraph.** The placements a view can give an action now read `rowActions` / `bulkActions` / `bulkActionDefs`; the placement lint counts all three (contract record 7062828763, N2).
- **`list_toolbar` row.** It said a bulk action receives `input.selectedIds`; no path delivers that key. The row now reads: toolbar button; one ticked row is its `recordId`, several are refused (no `_selectedIds`) (N1 of the same record).
- **Bulk bullet, first sentence.** Names both list-view wirings and what each hands the body, as above.
- **`AddToCampaignAction` example.** Declares `execution: 'perRecord'`, carries no `list_toolbar` placement (the list view names it in `bulkActions`), and its body inserts one `campaign_member` row for `ctx.recordId`. The loop over an id array, the `campaignId` alias and the `return { count }` line are gone.
- **`PrintA3Action` example** (the fold row on the card: the closed card about the new-tab example). `target` used a `record.id` hole; the runner substitutes only the `param` and `ctx` scopes. It now uses the `ctx.recordId` hole and sits on `record_header`, which has a record.

Changeset `.changeset/35647-ui-bulk-selected-ids.md`, `@objectstack/skills` patch. Its sentence now reads: no bulk body receives `input.selectedIds`; a name in `bulkActions` runs the action once per ticked row, its body reading `ctx.recordId`; only a `bulkActionDefs` entry with `operation: 'custom', execution: 'aggregate'` runs it once, the ids in `input._selectedIds`; plus the new-tab example line.

Review findings of contract record 7062828763, as closed at this head:

- S1: the changeset keeps the two wirings apart (sentence above).
- S2: removed the refusal clause (contract record 7062828763).
- N1 and N2: folded in (row and opening paragraph above).
- N3 not taken: `successMessage` stays on the example.

<details><summary>Trace on origin/main 3c06fc53: what a bulk body receives</summary>

- Toolbar button: `resolveServerActionRecordId` in `ui/packages/core/src/actions/serverActionHandler.ts`. With no `_selectedIds` in the bag, one ticked row becomes `recordId`, several ticked rows are refused, none sends no record. No id array is sent under any key.
- Per-row wiring: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/resolveBulkActions.ts` promotes a `bulkActions` name to one dispatch per row; `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts` hands the body that row's id as `ctx.recordId`.
- Aggregate wiring: `wantsAggregateResolve` in `resolveBulkActions.ts` asks for `execution === 'aggregate'`, `operation === 'custom'` and a name; the dispatch adds `_selectedIds` to the params, and the body-runner sets a body's `input` to them.
- `execution` on the action: `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` describes `'perRecord'` as one dispatch per selected row carrying that row's `recordId`, the `bulkActions` bare-name form.
- Placement: `packages/lint/src/validate-action-locations.ts` reads `rowActions`, `bulkActions` and each `bulkActionDefs` entry's name.
- URL holes: `interpolateTarget` in `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` builds its scopes from `param` and `ctx`.

</details>

## Evals

`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`, case 3 only (Convert plus bulk "Add to campaign"). It pinned the wrong teaching: `must_contain` held `list_toolbar` and `selectedIds`, and the expected answer read `input.selectedIds`.

- `expected_output`: the bulk action declares `execution: 'perRecord'`, is wired by the lead list view's `bulkActions`, and its body runs once per ticked row and reads that row's id as `ctx.recordId`.
- `must_contain`: `list_toolbar` and `selectedIds` are replaced by `bulkActions` and `ctx.recordId`.
- `must_not_contain`: adds `input.selectedIds`.

No eval round was run (a round is the eval seat's). The prompt is unchanged; both token lists changed, so earlier records of this case are set apart on a regrade.

## Tests

All readings at head `a7f91e14`.

<details><summary>Token ratchet, size and line budget</summary>

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md is 3701 tokens (ceiling 3711; headroom 10)`. On the merge base `7ba22bb6ee`: 3708 tokens (14830 bytes; now 14804). No ceiling row moved.
- `rules/actions.md` whole file: 261 lines before, 256 after. Every `SKILL.md` summed: 4945 lines before and after (none touched).
- Ratcheted authored total 197415 tokens; eval fixtures (measured, not ratcheted) 76671; bundle total 288685.
- PR net added lines (`git diff --numstat` against the merge base, changeset included): 20 added, 17 deleted, net +3. Budget 15.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates run locally</summary>

- Derived list (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 47 commands): 41 run, all exit 0, each exit code captured before any pipe. Among them the ratchet and its `--self-test`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check:skill-links`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:role-word`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: `47 derived, 41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 6 UNRUN`. The six need built `dist/` trees and are left to CI (declared narrowing): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:published-files`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`.
- Eval file: parses as JSON, 23 cases; case 3 has every `must_contain` token in its own `expected_output` (0 missing); 0 `must_not_contain` hits across the file.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/area-a4A-35647`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`.
- Not re-run locally at this head, left to CI: `check:skill-examples` (the fenced example blocks are byte-identical to `d2db0a8b`, where `Type Check · source gates` concluded success) and the skill-evals vitest file (the eval file did not move after `d2db0a8b`).

</details>

No ablation: the diff changes prose, an example and an eval fixture, no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's ask was to name the key delivered to a `list_toolbar` bulk handler. Measured answer: a `list_toolbar` placement delivers no id array; the selection reaches a body only through the list view's two wirings. The text teaches those, which is wider than swapping one spelling.
- The fold record on the card lists the new-tab example as a row of this card; it is fixed here in place.
- A `type: 'url'` action on `list_toolbar` can still carry the selection through the runner's `ctx.selection.ids` hole. The spec's `target` description does not list that hole, so the skill does not teach it. Noted, not filed.
- The example action carries no `locations`; the list view naming it is its placement.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, the first sentence of the bulk bullet under "Visibility, Disable & Feedback": it carries the wiring contract.
2. Same file, `AddToCampaignAction`: `execution: 'perRecord'` and a body that writes one row for `ctx.recordId`.
3. `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`, case 3 token lists.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `rules/actions.md is 3701 tokens (ceiling 3711; headroom 10)` and exits 0.
